confidence.scope: prespecified horizons x arms x conditions (x selected model seeds)
confidence.model_seed_pooling: forbidden; summarize each model seed separately

empirical_T_epsilon.interpretation: largest qualifying empirical sample grid horizon; no interpolation or population guarantee

confidence_supported_T_epsilon_lower_bou.interpretation: simultaneous confidence-supported lower bound on T_epsilon

step_accuracy.interpretation: per-step correctness; recovery does not change first-failure survival

execution.diagnostic_invalid_row_policy: after state nonfinite detection, failed rows use zero placeholders and all later predictions remain failures; a nonfinite readout alone marks that prediction invalid while the finite state continues; BOS readout is unscored

ledger.scope: exact serialized recurrent cache plus shared codec/basis/token table; common checkpoint separate; temporary workspaces excluded

read_boundary: updated packed state plus decoded residual after write
